item.title: NO DEAL: Nurses at NY-Presbyterian overwhelmingly vote to stay on strike
item.description: “This has always been about getting a fair contract. We never wanted to go on strike… We want to do our jobs, we love our jobs, but we can only return when our patients are being cared for safely… with more staffing and job security.”

item.title: Data center giant secures $14 million deal to consume 40% of Pennsylvania town’s excess water
item.description: The data center will get access to 400,000 gallons of water per day—enough to serve over 2,300 homes.

item.title: SOS: The US is manufacturing a humanitarian crisis in Cuba
item.description: “I need to believe that Cuba is going to survive this. We are survivors, the whole Cuban population. But the situation is really critical…”

item.title: They won their strike fair and square. Now their rich bosses are closing up shop.
item.description: After more than three years on strike at the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette, Newspaper Guild of Pittsburgh members won and finally returned to work. Now, the wealthy Block family is closing the paper.

item.title: Peter Thiel is unleashing a neocolonial billionaire fantasy in Honduras
item.description: Tech billionaires want to create their own city-states. Hondurans pay the price.

item.title: A $1B ‘therapeutic’ illusion: advocates fight Baltimore’s new jail
item.description: Former political prisoner Mansa Musa takes you inside the growing coalition that is uniting to stop Maryland’s proposed $1 billion "therapeutic" jail in this blockbuster documentary report.

item.title: This Tennessee prison is leaving LGBTQ people unhoused behind bars
item.description: The South Central Correctional Center leaves LGBTQ people defenseless, so they’re organizing to fight for their safety.

item.title: The secret tool AI uses to seduce you: explained

item.description: “HANDS OFF IRAN Mr. TRUMP,” said Yanis Varoufakis. “And to the rest of us: Let’s do whatever it takes to oppose another war crime—this time against the Iranian people.”

item.title: Homeland Empire | Under the Shadow S2E6
item.description: We are seeing an unprecedented reorganization of domestic and foreign policy in the United States. Both of them deployed to achieve the same goal — punish the opposition to Trump. Punish his political opponents. This is episode 6 of Under the Shadow, Season 2.
